title.zh: 伊朗外长称通过斡旋方与美国的谈判仍在继续，拒绝透露美方附加条件
title.en: 伊朗外长称通过斡旋方与美国的谈判仍在继续，拒绝透露美方附加条件

current_state.zh: Iran's foreign minister said indirect negotiations with the US through Pakistani and Qatari mediators are ongoing, that Washington accepted Tehran's seven-day plan conditions but wants extra undisclosed clauses, and that full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz was slated for day six of that plan.
current_state.en: Iran's foreign minister said indirect negotiations with the US through Pakistani and Qatari mediators are ongoing, that Washington accepted Tehran's seven-day plan conditions but wants extra undisclosed clauses, and that full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz was slated for day six of that plan.
